reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's V4 model: V3 linear single-track (Cα=1.5e5,1.5e5 from out/ladder_results.json) with per-segment straight-bias subtraction, plus a Ridge(alpha=1) residual correction trained on the agent's 60 Mach-E training segments.
notes: Agent's V4 is a Ridge residual learner trained with LOO across the agent's 60 Mach-E segments — no saved coefficients. Reconstruction fits ONE Ridge on those 60 segments (target = V3 signed residual with per-seg straight bias) and applies it to all 545 canonical Ford segments; V3 uses the agent's fit Cα=(1.5e5,1.5e5) which the agent's own JSON reports were pegged at the initial guess. Per-segment straight-line bias is recomputed on each canonical segment to mirror the agent's pipeline, since bias is intrinsically per-segment. Pooling across Ford platforms (Mach-E + F-150) loses fidelity: the Ridge model was trained on Mach-E only, and V3 uses each platform's own params.
